title: Choose the visual world for VFI
question: The roll assigned The Team Workspace. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Team Workspace
options.lineage: Feishu / Lark docs and multi-dimensional tables, the screen your audience lives in every day
options.thesis: VFI shown as a page in your team's own workspace: calls arrive as rows, every assistant is a document.
options.viewport: A doc-style page: the headline is the doc title; beside it, a live call table fills row by row overnight (synthetic), one row open to its summary.
options.risk: If the craft slips it reads like a generic SaaS dashboard instead of a signature world.

raised.raise: One governing line: a continuous 24-hour call timeline runs the length of the page and orders every section.
One fact per full-width row: pricing and setup each get a row with a real measured number, set in tabular figures.
Selecting a call row isolates it and dims the rest, then opens transcript, summary and next step.
An honest state vocabulary everywhere: activating, ready, low balance, on a call, failed.
Palette locked to ink, one blue and two status colors, with no gradients or glow.

regions.label: top bar: VFI mark, nav, language

options.label: Day Line, Night Line
options.lineage: dual world clocks in a trading room or hotel lobby
options.thesis: The page is split by the time difference: your night in Shanghai, your customer's afternoon in the US, and VFI answering across the seam.
options.viewport: Full-width split: left half is your city at 2:14 AM, right half is the US at 1:14 PM; a call card crosses the seam and is answered.
options.risk: A strong single idea that can get thin on deeper pages; the split metaphor has to translate into the app.

options.label: Curved Crease Shell
options.thesis: One arc lifts the page into form.
options.viewport: A cream disc folding along one charcoal arc.
options.case: Fuses poorly: founders entering the US don't identify with paper geometry, and the offer gets lost.
options.kept: One governing line orders the whole page.

options.label: Forge Blow
options.thesis: Each blow visibly changes the metal.
options.viewport: A glowing billet under the hammer.
options.case: Fuses poorly: industrial violence misreads a calm receptionist, and its stencil caps break the no-caps rule.
options.kept: One fact per full-width row with measured numbers.

options.label: Collider Event Display
options.thesis: Every call as an event bursting from one point.
options.viewport: A ring section with call tracks curling outward.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it's the near-black-and-neon look every voice-AI site already ships, and it reads as lab equipment.
options.kept: Select one item to isolate it and dim the rest.
options.risk: Lands right in the category's rut.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.thesis: Status as cloth courses stepping under a window.
options.viewport: A stalled blind between two destinations.
options.case: Fuses poorly: built for monitoring, it needs all-caps legends and doesn't explain the offer.
options.risk: Caps-only type conflicts with a brand rule.

options.label: Kiosk Print Ephemera
options.thesis: Every product cell printed in the same three inks.
options.viewport: A kiosk grid of printed goods.
options.case: Fuses poorly: it carries political and nostalgic connotations this audience may not want next to a US-market product.
options.kept: A restricted palette held with total commitment.

options.label: Polar Ice Press
options.lineage: expedition newspapers printed on the ice
options.thesis: A hand-set bulletin printed where nobody else could.
options.viewport: A hand-set masthead with one plate.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the romance of isolation doesn't explain an AI phone assistant.
options.kept: Constraints stated in place, not buried.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The voice-AI landing page as Retell, Vapi and Synthflow ship it, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: A big centered headline over a dark gradient, a 'talk to the assistant' orb, two buttons, then feature grid and pricing.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
